title: feat(console): the approvals inbox opens a request on its served page, and the side sheet is deleted (objectui#12484)
body:
Fixes #12484
Clause-②: no

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer). The inbox loses its own request view; nothing is added in its place but a navigation to the standard record route.

The closing card that ruling `6190549995` on objectui#12438 directs (letter C, item 1): one PR mounts the served page where the sheet is, deletes the sheet, and lists each retired pin against the user report it came from.

## What changes (`@object-ui/console` only)

- **The inbox opens a request on its served page.** A desktop row, a mobile card, Enter on the focused row, and the notification deep link `/system/approvals?request=ID` all navigate to `/apps/APP/sys_approval_request/record/ID`: the console's standard record route, where `RecordDetailView` mounts the page objectstack serves for a request (`sys_approval_request_detail`) and reads it through `ApprovalRecordReads` (PR #12432). The deep link is a `Navigate replace`: the request page takes the deep link's place in history, so Back leaves to where the reader came from, and the queue is not read on the way.
- **The side sheet is deleted**, with its reads (`getRequest`, `listActions`, the reply), its keyboard pager and every helper only it used (the payload summary, the record-field face, the position-label read, the approver chips, the decision-progress block, the step stepper, the activity list). It lived inline in `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`; it had no component file of its own.
- The queue is unchanged: tabs, filters, sorting, the row and card faces (amount, tombstone, cause-free reference, refused link), inline and bulk decisions, keyboard j/k/x/a/r.
- **The served-page pins follow objectui's pin** (`06cab4849a8a`, carrying objectstack `b9d0c48a5d`). The eight `approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPage*` copies of `sys_approval_request` now read: `nameField` `process_label`, `titleFormat` `{process_name}`; `highlightFields` and the strip name `process_label` and `current_step_label`; `object_name` is out of the strip. Their rows carry `process_label` / `current_step_label`, drop the `display_title` value the approvals get does not serve, and the human-submitted rows get a `submitter_id` (the seat note `6246960490`).
- No `@object-ui/*` export, prop, option, spec key or language-pack key changes. Nothing under `packages/` is touched.

## How the inbox opens a request: a navigation, not an in-place mount

The ruling says the page is mounted "where the sheet is" and the sheet is deleted. It does not say whether the page opens inside the inbox or on its own route. This takes the shape that reuses the served route as it is:

- PR #12432 already serves the page on the standard record route, through `ApprovalRecordReads`, for every surface that opens a request. A navigation adds no second mount of `RecordDetailView`, and no surface whose pins would have to be written again.
- An open request is addressable state (AGENTS.md #8): its URL is the record route, which survives a refresh and is shareable. The sheet held it in component state and stripped the deep link from the URL.
- In-place mounting would have kept a sheet (`RecordDetailView embedded` inside a `Sheet`), which is the component the ruling deletes.

### Kept, with the reason

The queue stays, so its pins stay:

- `ApprovalsInboxPage.cellIdentity` (objectui#5348, row cells across a clock tick);
- `displayLocale-10375` (objectui#10375, queue dates);
- `pageHeader-12526`, `pinnedActions-12816`, `tableOverflow-12708` and `waitingOnOthers-12608` (the page header, the pinned decision column, the overflow box, the empty pending tab);
- `queueHiddenAmount` (objectui#6020, queue rows and the amount sort);
- `recordLink` (objectui#5211, queue rows only).

The card listed `recordLink` and `queueHiddenAmount` under faces, but both pin only the queue.

- `recordLinkRefused-11878`: its six queue cases.
- `tombstone`: the `isDeletedRecordReference` unit cases and its queue cases.
- `unresolvableReference`: the `isUnresolvableRecordReference` unit cases and its queue cases.
- `consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909`: the queue half (the row's amount and its submitted-at tooltip, both locales, and the machine-locale tripwire).

The classification was re-read at BASE `3aa2f52`. The 19 files are the same 19 the previous table read at `b017621`, and none of them changed in between.

### Ruled deltas: faces the served page shows less of (ADR-0060 rule 3: "may only shrink")

1. **Fail-closed summary.** The sheet's FAILS OPEN cases (`hiddenFieldTrim` "a source that cannot describe the object renders today's card", and the one in `summaryFaces-11677`) drew the raw snapshot when the target object's definition could not be read. The served page draws no summary then: `servedPageSummary-12483` "CONTROL: without the target object's definition nothing is summarized, and the panel still decides". objectui#12483 recorded the choice in PR #12533's body, verbatim: "with no definition there is no summary (the sheet falls back to the raw snapshot)". The seat ruled it a delta in the safe direction, so these cases retire.
2. **No key-name guess for the amount.** Also from PR #12533's body, verbatim: "only a declared `currency` field leads (the sheet's key-name guess is not ported; the showcase's `summary` roll-up totals become ordinary rows)". The summary of a currency field leads since objectui#12534.
3. **The flow origin reads a null submitter.** The served page marks a request served with no `submitter_id`. The sheet's `flow:` sentinel-id branch is not ported; `servedPageStepLine-12491`'s header says why, and its CONTROL pins the person-submitted case.

## Measured first: the H1 blocker is gone at the pin

The previous dispatch stopped because the served H1 printed the record id (report `6278302629`). At objectui's pin `06cab4849a8a`, `sys_approval_request` declares `nameField` / `displayNameField` = `process_label` and `titleFormat` `{process_name}` (read from `sys-approval-request.object.ts` at that commit). The 12489 harness, with the pin's definition copied, now reads the H1 as `Invoice Approval` (the flow's label) in the readable, deleted and unresolvable states. In the deleted and unresolvable states, `document.body.innerHTML` holds the subject id nowhere.

**Reverse leg R1** (one-shot, through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0): the old title definition (`nameField: 'display_title'`, `titleFormat: '{process_name} · {record_id}'`) put back into the 12489 copy. Predicted 3 red / 5 green; got 3 red / 5 green:

- readable: Received `flow:invoice_approval · Rd4bl3Rec12489QQ`;
- deleted: Received `flow:invoice_approval · D3l3t3dRec12489Q`;
- unresolvable: Received `flow:invoice_approval · Un0penRec12489QQ`.

These reproduce the previous dispatch's measurement exactly. Restore: blob `f51fc03c32f5` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Tests

At head `d0908481b`, `pnpm exec vitest run` over these 44 files passed (369 tests), lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`:

- every file under `apps/console/src/pages/system/` and `apps/console/src/services/` that names approvals;
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/approvalsInboxComponentRef.test.tsx`, `AppContent.approvalRecordReads.test.tsx` and `apps/console/src/pages/consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx`;
- every counterpart above: app-shell `views/approval-decision/`, `views/approval-progress/`, `utils/approverIdentity*`, and the three `packages/fields` files named above.

New pin: `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484.test.tsx`. It mounts the REAL inbox and, on the record route, the REAL `RecordDetailView` under `ApprovalRecordReads`, with the served page copied whole at the pin. Each way in lands on the record route: a row, Enter, the mobile card and the deep link. There, the decision panel and the H1 draw. No dialog mounts, and the sheet's reads are not made. The deep link replaces itself in history (Back goes home) and reads no queue. A CONTROL keeps the queue on the inbox route.

Chromium: NOT MEASURED. No cheap harness exists: a browser reading needs an objectstack backend plus a console dev server. The unit harness above mounts the real `RecordDetailView` and the real route.

## Acceptance notes

- **Unpinned sheet faces the served page does not carry.** These shrink under rule 3 and gate nothing. PR #12432's gap table already named the first three as "lost and unpinned":
  - the request view's Previous / Next pager, with its ←/→ keys;
  - the SLA and round chips inside the request view (the queue rows keep both);
  - the "why can't I act" hint.

  Also gone with the sheet:
  - the pending tab's advance to the next request after a decision;
  - the inline reply box (the served page's reply is the declared `approval_comment` action);
  - the returned request's "Edit record" button (the served Details tab's record card links the target when the reader may read it);
  - the opening of a timeline attachment. Whether the served Timeline tab's `attachments` cell opens one: NOT MEASURED.
- **Dead code left outside this claim.** `approvalsApi.getRequest`, `listActions` and `comment` (in `apps/console/src/services/approvalsApi.ts`) have no non-test caller now. The sheet-only `approvalsInbox.*` keys in the ten language packs (`packages/i18n`) have no call site either. `check:i18n-dead-keys` cannot see them, because the inbox builds its keys from the template head `approvalsInbox.`. Carrier: none.
- **Stale comments outside this claim:**
  - `apps/console/src/registerApprovalsComponents.tsx` still says `?request=ID` reaches the page's "drawer opener";
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.test.tsx` cites `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` by two line addresses as a `DeclaredActionsBar` host, and the inbox hosts none now;
